title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Financial Management → GeneralLedger
architecture_notes: Workday Financials uses worktags rather than chartfields. Every financial transaction is coded with a combination of worktags: Ledger Account, Fund, Cost Center, Revenue Category, Spend Category, Grant, Program, Gift, etc. Worktags are hierarchical and institution-configurable. Data extraction via: RaaS (custom financial reports), Workday Prism Analytics, Workday REST API (Financial Management), or Workday Data Cloud (zero-copy with AWS).

source_objects.description: Journal header: journal number, ledger, date, status, accounting date, created by. Equivalent to PS_JRNL_HEADER.
Journal line detail: ledger account, worktags (fund, cost center, spend category, etc.), debit/credit amount, memo. Equivalent to PS_JRNL_LN.
Chart of accounts: account number, name, type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense). Equivalent to PS_GL_ACCOUNT_TBL.
Period-end balances by worktag combination. Equivalent to PS_LEDGER.
System-generated accounting entries from sub-ledger transactions (AP, AR, Payroll). Source journals.
